question: 各区域有多少家门店？
reference_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS store_count FROM stores GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

question: 2026年第二季度各区域销售额是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT s.region, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.sale_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM stores AS s JOIN orders AS o ON o.store_id = s.store_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY s.region

question: 2026年第二季度销售额最高的5个商品类别是什么？
reference_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.sale_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: 2026年第二季度各区域订单数和客单价是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT s.region, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.sale_price * (1 - oi.discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS average_order_value FROM stores AS s JOIN orders AS o ON o.store_id = s.store_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY s.region

question: 2026年6月各门店销售目标完成率是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT s.store_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.sale_price * (1 - oi.discount)) / st.revenue_target * 100, 2) AS target_completion_rate FROM stores AS s JOIN orders AS o ON o.store_id = s.store_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales_targets AS st ON st.store_id = s.store_id AND st.target_month = '2026-06-01' WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, st.revenue_target ORDER BY target_completion_rate DESC

question: 各城市有多少家门店？
reference_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS store_count FROM stores GROUP BY city ORDER BY city

question: 2026年6月销售额最高的5家门店是什么？

question: 2026年第二季度各商品类别的平均折扣率是多少？

question: 2026年第二季度各种退货原因分别有多少次？
reference_sql: SELECT return_reason, COUNT(*) AS return_count FROM returns WHERE return_date >= '2026-04-01' AND return_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY return_reason ORDER BY return_reason

question: 2026年第二季度各商品类别的退货件次和售出明细数是多少？
reference_sql: WITH sold AS (SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) AS sold_item_count FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY p.category), returned AS (SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) AS return_count FROM products AS p JOIN returns AS r ON r.product_id = p.product_id WHERE r.return_date >= '2026-04-01' AND r.return_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY p.category) SELECT sold.category, sold.sold_item_count, COALESCE(returned.return_count, 0) AS return_count FROM sold LEFT JOIN returned ON returned.category = sold.category ORDER BY sold.category

question: 2026年6月30日各商品类别的库存总量是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(i.stock_qty) AS total_stock_qty FROM inventory AS i JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date = '2026-06-30' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

question: 2026年6月30日库存少于10件的门店商品有哪些？

question: 2026年第二季度各门店三个月的销售目标总额是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT s.store_name, ROUND(SUM(st.revenue_target), 2) AS quarterly_target FROM stores AS s JOIN sales_targets AS st ON st.store_id = s.store_id WHERE st.target_month >= '2026-04-01' AND st.target_month < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name ORDER BY s.store_name

question: 2025年第四季度每个月新注册了多少客户？

question: 2026年6月金额最高的一笔已完成订单是多少？

question: 2026年第二季度星期几的销售额最高？

question: 2026年6月30日各区域按商品成本计算的库存金额是多少？

question: 2026年6月哪些门店没有完成销售目标？
reference_sql: SELECT s.store_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.sale_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue, st.revenue_target FROM stores AS s JOIN orders AS o ON o.store_id = s.store_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sales_targets AS st ON st.store_id = s.store_id AND st.target_month = '2026-06-01' WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, st.revenue_target HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.sale_price * (1 - oi.discount)) < st.revenue_target ORDER BY s.store_name
